project.name: FRAMED Interop (aggregator)
project.description: Standards-based interoperability at the socket edge, split per standard so framework consumers import only the boundary they need: shared mapping/gate (common), HL7 v2.x over MLLP (hl7), MQTT (mqtt), IEEE 11073 SDC (sdc). FRAMED's internal flow stays on the EAV model throughout.
